name: Finding and using information from text to answer questions
gist: These papers help models search through documents and retrieve relevant facts to answer questions more accurately, combining language models with information retrieval.
explain: Models trained on internet text have knowledge baked into their parameters, but that knowledge is limited to what was in the training data and is fixed after training ends. If you ask a model a question about recent events, it will fail because it has not seen them. Papers in this area solve this by giving models access to external documents—they pair a language model with a retrieval system that searches through a large collection of texts, finds relevant passages, and shows them to the model. The model then reads those passages and answers the question based on what it found. This is like letting the model use Google and then reason about the results.

The challenge is making this actually work well. Retrieval systems sometimes find passages that are relevant but do not answer the question, or they miss the right passage and the model has to guess anyway. Papers study how to make retrieval better by ranking search results more carefully, how to decide when retrieval is necessary versus when the model can answer from its own knowledge, and how to teach models to actually use the retrieved passages to build an answer. Some papers also study combining this with reasoning steps, so a model can search for information, reason about it, realize it needs more information, and search again.

The payoff is that models can now answer questions about documents they have never seen before, can access recent information, and can work with private documents without needing to retrain. This opens up applications like question-answering over medical records, legal documents, or a company's internal knowledge base. The technique is also more interpretable than pure memorization—when a model gives an answer, you can point to the exact passage it used, which builds trust.

papers.title: AgentSynth: Scalable Task Generation for Generalist Computer-Use Agents
papers.contribution: AgentSynth creates over 6,000 diverse tasks at average cost of $0.60 per trajectory (orders of magnitude cheaper than humans), with benchmarks showing steep performance degradation from 18% at difficulty 1 to 4% at level 6.

papers.title: Autoencoding-Free Context Compression for LLMs via Contextual Semantic Anchors
papers.contribution: Eliminates autoencoding training requirement; consistently outperforms existing compression methods on context compression tasks without training overhead.

papers.title: COMI: Coarse-to-fine Context Compression via Marginal Information Gain
papers.contribution: COMI achieves approximately 25-point Exact Match improvement under 32x compression constraint with Qwen2-7B on NaturalQuestions compared to existing baselines.

papers.title: CausalRAG2: Hierarchical Causal Knowledge Graph Design for RAG
papers.contribution: CausalRAG2 consistently outperforms competitive graph-based RAG baselines on multiple datasets, establishing a principled foundation for structured, scalable, and causally grounded RAG.

papers.title: Decentralized Instruction Tuning: Conflict-Aware Splitting and Weight Merging
papers.contribution: On Qwen2.5-VL-3B with 136 Vision-FLAN tasks, MERIT improves the 8-benchmark average from 54.3 (joint training) to 57.0, and scales to a 7B model on 1.6M-example, 176-source mixture while matching centralized joint training with minimal overhead.

papers.title: DeepRAG: Thinking to Retrieve Step by Step for Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Improves retrieval efficiency and boosts answer accuracy by 25.41%.

papers.title: FlexRank: Nested Low-Rank Knowledge Decomposition for Adaptive Model Deployment
papers.contribution: Enable train-once-deploy-everywhere paradigm with graceful cost-performance trade-offs without retraining for each budget.

papers.title: FreqKV: Key-Value Compression in Frequency Domain for Context Window Extension
papers.contribution: Extends LLaMA-2-7B context window to 256K tokens while maintaining stable perplexity, outperforming existing KV compression methods on both prefilling and decoding.

papers.title: Panini: Continual Learning in Token Space via Structured Memory
papers.contribution: PANINI achieves 5-7% higher average performance than baselines on six QA benchmarks while using 2-30× fewer answer-context tokens and reducing unsupported answers.

papers.title: Query-Level Uncertainty in Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Outperforms several baselines in detecting knowledge boundaries and enables efficient adaptive inference mechanisms.

papers.title: Revisiting the Past: Data Unlearning with Model State History
papers.contribution: MSA achieves competitive or better performance than existing machine unlearning algorithms across multiple benchmarks, models, and metrics.

papers.title: Addressing Semantic Blind Spots in Text-to-SQL via Component Pre-generation and AST Matching Rewards
papers.contribution: Achieves 65.78% execution accuracy on BIRD-dev and state-of-the-art performance on Spider-syn datasets with comparable parameter scales.

papers.title: Beyond Real: Imaginary Extension of Rotary Position Embeddings for Long-Context LLMs
papers.contribution: Improves long-context language modeling performance over standard RoPE, with benefits scaling with context length, on multiple long-context benchmarks.

papers.title: CFT-RAG: An Entity Tree Based Retrieval Augmented Generation Algorithm With Cuckoo Filter
papers.contribution: Achieves over 800% speedup compared to naive Tree-RAG on DART dataset while maintaining high generative quality.

papers.title: CerebraGloss: Instruction-Tuning a Large Vision-Language Model for Fine-Grained Clinical EEG Interpretation
papers.contribution: First model for unified generative EEG analysis surpassing GPT-5 on CerebraGloss-Bench and achieving state-of-the-art on TUSZ seizure detection.

papers.title: CircuitPrint: Mechanistic Circuit Fingerprints for Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Substantially outperforms existing baselines while remaining robust under aggressive fine-tuning and model merging without altering model parameters.

papers.title: CoDA-Bench: Can Code Agents Handle Data-Intensive Tasks?
papers.contribution: Top-performing agents achieve only 61.1% success, highlighting substantial gap in data discovery and code execution integration.

papers.title: Context-Driven Incremental Compression for Multi-Turn Dialogue Generation
papers.contribution: C-DIC maintains near-constant inference time and stable perplexity over hundreds of dialogue turns, outperforming existing methods on long-form benchmarks.

papers.title: Copy-Paste to Mitigate Large Language Model Hallucinations
papers.contribution: CopyPasteLLM achieves 12.2% to 24.5% accuracy improvements on FaithEval over baselines while requiring only 365 training samples.

papers.title: Counterfactual Reasoning for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.contribution: CF-RAG substantially improves robustness against the Correlation Trap on challenging benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art performance while maintaining comparable efficiency to standard RAG.

papers.title: Cyber-Zero: Training Cybersecurity Agents without Runtime
papers.contribution: Cyber-Zero-32B achieves up to 13.1% absolute performance gains over baselines on three prominent CTF benchmarks and matches the capabilities of proprietary systems like DeepSeek-V3-0324 and Claude-3.5-Sonnet.

papers.title: Dispersion Loss Counteracts Embedding Condensation and Improves Generalization in Small Language Models
papers.contribution: Dispersion loss recovers dispersion patterns seen in larger models and yields performance gains across 10 benchmarks.

papers.title: Distribution-Calibrated Inference Time Compute for Thinking LLM-as-a-Judge
papers.contribution: Distribution-aware aggregation reduces MAE and increases pairwise accuracy on evaluation benchmarks, matching or exceeding individual human raters when calibrated against human consensus.

papers.title: EvolProver: Advancing Automated theorem proving by Evolving Formalized Problems via Symmetry and Difficulty
papers.contribution: Achieves 53.8% pass@32 on FormalMATH-Lite and new SOTA on multiple benchmarks for non-reasoning 7B models via evolved training data.

papers.title: Free Energy Mixer
papers.contribution: FEM consistently outperforms baselines on NLP, vision, and time-series tasks at matched parameter budgets.

papers.title: From Conflict to Consensus: Boosting Medical Reasoning via Multi-Round Agentic RAG
papers.contribution: MA-RAG surpasses inference-time scaling and RAG baselines, delivering substantial +6.8 points average accuracy on 7 medical Q&A benchmarks by leveraging inconsistency as proactive signal for multi-round reasoning.

papers.title: From Retrieval to Translation: Translating Query into Graph-level Clues for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms baselines on five datasets by translating queries to graph clues instead of traditional matching-based paradigms.

papers.title: From Volume to Value: Preference-Aligned Memory Construction for On-Device RAG
papers.contribution: Reduces indexing memory by 2,404× while improving preference-following accuracy by 18.79 percentage points, maintaining under 1 MB memory with 5.21-29.35 ms/query latency.

papers.title: GAM-RAG: Gain-Adaptive Memory for Evolving Retrieval in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.contribution: GAM-RAG improves average performance by 3.95% and by 8.19% with 5-turn memory while reducing inference cost by 61%.

papers.title: GRO-RAG: Gradient-aware Re-rank Optimization for Multi-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.contribution: Gradient-based selection approximates optimal subset minimizing generation loss; consistent improvements on multi-source QA and open-domain generation.

papers.title: Guidance: Sentence-Level Citation Enforcement via Prefix-Tail Guidance during LLM Decoding
papers.contribution: Improves citation F1 score by 11.2% over state-of-the-art baselines with training-free approach pluggable into general or fine-tuned LLMs.

papers.title: Hierarchical Abstract Tree for Cross-Document Retrieval Augmented Generation
papers.contribution: Outperforms RAPTOR by 25.9% and HippoRAG 2 by 7.4% in average F1 score on cross-document multi-hop QA benchmarks.

papers.title: How Learning Rate Decay Wastes Your Best Data in Curriculum-Based LLM Pretraining
papers.contribution: Improves average benchmark score by 1.64% over random shuffling on 1.5B-parameter models trained over 30B tokens, without additional data refinement.

papers.title: How Transformers Learn Causal Structures In-Context: Explainable Mechanism Meets Theoretical Guarantee
papers.contribution: Proves two-layer transformer can implement Bayesian Model Averaging for optimal causal structure inference; attention patterns directly reflect inferred structures.

papers.title: How to train data-efficient LLMs
papers.contribution: Shows AskLLM consistently outperforms full-data training by 10% sampling and converges 70% faster, establishing data-efficient pre-training as viable alternative to full-dataset training.

papers.title: In-Context Learning as Rate–Distortion Optimization
papers.contribution: RDCO improves 10-dataset classification average by 2.20 points and generation by 2.26 points under the same token budget.

papers.title: JADE: Bridging the Strategic-Operational Gap in Dynamic Agentic RAG
papers.contribution: Transforms disjoint modules into synergistic system yielding strong performance improvements via joint optimization with flexible balance between efficiency and effectiveness.

papers.title: KORE: Enhancing Knowledge Injection for Large Multimodal Models via Knowledge-Oriented Controls
papers.contribution: KORE achieves superior new knowledge injection and effectively mitigates catastrophic forgetting across LLaVA-v1.5 and Qwen2.5-VL models.

papers.title: LUGS: Latent-aware Guidance for Efficient Unmasking in Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Improves performance by over 1% on Science and Reason tasks, achieves average 3.5% improvement in code generation, and outperforms beam search baseline by over 5% on average on code tasks using LLaDA-8B-Instruct.

papers.title: Learned Meta-Tokens for Language Modeling
papers.contribution: Meta-tokens enable length generalization up to 2x context window extension with strong synthetic task performance and mechanistic insights into context compression.

papers.title: Less is Enough: Synthesizing Diverse Data in LLM Feature Space with Sparse Autoencoders
papers.contribution: Consistently improves data diversity and downstream performance on instruction following, toxicity detection, reward modeling, behavior steering.

papers.title: LinearRAG: Linear Graph Retrieval Augmented Generation on Large-scale Corpora
papers.contribution: LinearRAG significantly outperforms baseline models on four benchmark datasets with economical and reliable indexing.

papers.title: Linguistic Nepotism: Trading-off Quality for Language Preference in Multilingual RAG
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that models preferentially cite English sources when queried in English and sometimes trade-off document relevance for language preference, indicating citation choices are not always informativeness-driven.

papers.title: LoKiFormer: Locality-aware Attention with Decoupled Knowledge Memory for Efficient Large Language Model Pretraining
papers.contribution: Converges 1.33x faster in pretraining than baseline models.

papers.title: ML-Embed: Inclusive and Efficient Embeddings for a Multilingual World
papers.contribution: ML-Embed sets new records on 9 of 17 MTEB benchmarks with particularly strong results in low-resource languages; releases all models, data, and code.

papers.title: Memora: A Harmonic Memory Representation Balancing Abstraction and Specificity
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art on LoCoMo and LongMemEval benchmarks, demonstrating improved retrieval relevance and reasoning effectiveness as memory scales.

papers.title: MergePRAG: Orthogonal Merging of Passage-experts for Multi-hop Parametric RAG
papers.contribution: MergePRAG outperforms standard and state-of-the-art RAG methods on multi-hop open-domain QA and reasoning-aware knowledge editing tasks with superior effectiveness and efficiency.

papers.title: OSCAR: Online Soft Compression for RAG
papers.contribution: Achieves 2-5x speed-up in inference with minimal accuracy loss across 1B-24B parameter LLMs through higher compression rates than existing methods.

papers.title: Q-RAG: Long Context Multi‑Step Retrieval via Value‑Based Embedder Training
papers.contribution: Offers competitive resource-efficient alternative achieving state-of-the-art results on long-context benchmarks with contexts up to 10M tokens.

papers.title: QuoKA: Query-Oriented KV Selection for Efficient LLM Prefill
papers.contribution: Achieves 3x reduction in time-to-first-token and up to 7x speedup on Intel CPUs while utilizing 88% fewer key-value pairs and maintaining near-baseline accuracy.

papers.title: RAG without Forgetting: Continual Query-Infused Key Memory
papers.contribution: Show query and key expansion are theoretically equivalent and prove convergence of ERM's updates, achieving consistent BEIR/BRIGHT gains at native retrieval speed.

papers.title: Reliable Fine-Grained Evaluation of Natural Language Math Proofs
papers.contribution:
Using ProofBench as a testbed, we systematically explore the evaluator design space across key axes: the backbone model, input context, instructions and evaluation workflow.
Our analysis delivers Proo

papers.title: Rethinking KV Cache Eviction via a Unified Information-Theoretic Objective
papers.contribution: CapKV consistently outperforms prior eviction methods, preserving maximum predictive signal while improving memory-fidelity trade-off.

papers.title: Retriever Portfolios: A Principled Approach to Adaptive RAG
papers.contribution: Learned portfolios with routers outperform single-retriever and naive multi-retriever baselines on QA benchmarks with lower latency and token cost than inference-time tuning.

papers.title: Revisiting Parameter-Based Knowledge Editing in Large Language Models: Theoretical Limits and Empirical Evidence
papers.contribution: Shows parameter-based editing methods consistently damage core LLM capabilities, while a simple retrieval-based baseline achieves consistently stronger performance across all evaluated conditions.

papers.title: SMILE: Extended Deep Submodular Function-Based Instruction and In-context Learning Demonstration Selection
papers.contribution: SMILE consistently outperforms instruction-only, demonstration-only, and existing joint baselines across six datasets and multiple LLM backbones.

papers.title: Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that SARDI outperforms training-free diffusion and autoregressive retrieval baselines at up to 8× higher throughput across five multi-hop QA benchmarks.

papers.title: Short Window Attention Enables Long-Term Memorization
papers.contribution: Short window attention encourages better xLSTM memory training; stochastic windows significantly outperform regular window attention on both short and long-context problems.

papers.title: SinkTrack: Attention Sink based Context Anchoring for Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Training-free, plug-and-play method reduces hallucination and context forgetting by 18.9% on QuAC and 23.0% on M3CoT without architectural changes.

papers.title: Stacked from One: Multi-Scale Self-Injection for Context Window Extension
papers.contribution: Achieves superior or comparable results to baselines on long-context tasks while reducing memory consumption and demonstrating substantial speed-ups.

papers.title: TG-RAG: A Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Reasoning Guidance in Specialized Domains
papers.contribution: Achieve competitive performance in specialized domains by ensuring faithful adherence to domain SOPs through active guidance without self-correction.

papers.title: TRACEDET: HALLUCINATION DETECTION FROM THE DECODING TRACE OF DIFFUSION LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
papers.contribution: TraceDet consistently improves hallucination detection with an average AUROC gain of 15.2% compared to baselines across various open-source diffusion LLMs.

papers.title: Taming the Fragility of KV Cache Eviction in LLM Inference
papers.contribution: Reduces generation quality loss by 2.3 times and 4.3 times compared to strongest baselines under 20% cache size across 18 datasets.

papers.title: Token-Free Hierarchical Indexing for RAG beyond LLM-based Summarization
papers.contribution: Significantly reduces indexing overhead while outperforming state-of-the-art methods on complex multi-hop reasoning tasks.

papers.title: VideoChat-Flash: Hierarchical Compression for Long-Context Video Modeling
papers.contribution: Achieves 1/50 compression ratio with minimal loss and achieves 99.1% accuracy on 10,000-frame needle-in-haystack benchmark.

papers.title: When Does Divide and Conquer Work for Long Context LLM? A Noise Decomposition Framework
papers.contribution: Explains why weaker chunked models can surpass advanced single-shot models on long inputs; identifies tractable chunking conditions via principled framework.

papers.title: Youtu-GraphRAG: Vertically Unified Agents for Graph Retrieval-Augmented Complex Reasoning
papers.contribution: Demonstrates robustness across six challenging benchmarks by jointly connecting graph construction with schema-aware extraction and dually-perceived community detection.
